f2.zh: 我们如何为家庭提供支持

f3.en: Whether you need hands-on care from the newborn stage through to school age, support for an elderly family member, or want to become a professional caregiver yourself, we're here to help.
f3.zh: 无论您需要从新生儿阶段到入学前的全程专业照护、为年长的家人寻找照护支持，还是想成为一名专业护理人员，我们都能为您提供帮助。

f5.en: Support for the postpartum period and newborn stage, including mother-and-baby care, overnight help where needed, and confinement meal (月子餐) preparation. Our care approach draws on Taiwan confinement-centre methods and traditional Chinese medicine-informed recovery concepts.
f5.zh: 为产后妈妈与新生宝宝提供月嫂照护支持，包括妈妈与宝宝护理、按需安排夜间照护，以及月子餐制作。我们的护理理念结合台湾月子中心护理手法与中医调理思路。

f6.zh: 长期保姆 / 育儿照护

f7.en: Longer-term nanny and childcare support for babies from around 2 months through to preschool or school age, with flexible live-in, live-out, day or overnight arrangements.
f7.zh: 为约2个月至入学前宝宝/儿童提供长期保姆与育儿照护支持，可根据家庭需要安排住家或非住家、白班或夜班服务。

f9.en: Companionship and gentle day-to-day support for older family members, such as conversation, errands, simple outings and regular visits. This is positioned as companion support, not medical or high-dependency care.
f9.zh: 为家中长辈提供温和的日常陪伴支持，例如聊天陪伴、简单外出、日常事务协助与定期探访。此服务定位为陪伴与生活支持，不包含医疗或高风险照护。

f12.en: Tell us your care type, location, dates, household setup and preferred contact channel.
f12.zh: 告诉我们服务类型、所在地区、预计时间、家庭安排与偏好联系方式。

f14.en: We shortlist suitable caregivers based on your family needs, language preference, schedule and location.
f14.zh: 我们根据家庭需求、语言偏好、服务时间与所在地区，为您筛选合适的护理人员。

f16.en: Meet the caregiver, ask questions, and confirm the arrangement only when both sides feel comfortable.
f16.zh: 与护理人员沟通面谈，确认服务细节；双方都满意后再进入正式确认。

f18.en: Care begins, with our coordination team continuing to follow up throughout the arrangement.
f18.zh: 服务正式开始后，我们的协调团队会在整个服务期间持续跟进支持。

f20.en: A practical training pathway for people in New Zealand who want to become professional postpartum caregivers, covering newborn care, postpartum nutrition, family communication and client-home service etiquette.
f20.zh: 面向新西兰本地有意成为专业月嫂的人士，系统学习新生儿照护、产后营养、家庭沟通，以及进入客户家庭服务前需要了解的服务礼仪。

f30.en: Before starting, the caregiver completes role-specific preparation so household details, expectations and service boundaries are clear.
f30.zh: 正式上岗前，护理人员会完成对应服务的岗前准备，确认家庭细节、服务边界与双方期待。
